name: 原声清晨绽放
lyrics:
[主歌1]

A brand new day is waiting just the same
The coffee steams, the birds begin to sing

Seasons turn but hope never dies
Every 黎明 renews what 夜 concealed

Stories waiting to be told

[副歌]

Blooming 明亮 beneath the golden 天空
Seasons turn but hope never dies
Every 黎明 renews what 夜 concealed

[桥段]

name: 低保真沉思黎明
lyrics:
[主歌1]

Morning 光芒 穿过 the window pane
Coffee steam rising, 轻柔 refrain
Pages turning, ink on skin
A quiet ritual begins

[副歌]

Golden hours, they don't last long
But this moment feels so strong
Every breath, a brand new start
Morning's 低语 at my heart

[主歌2]

City wakes beneath my feet
Streets still quiet, rhythms complete
Pen in hand, the world stands still
This is where the 梦境 distill

[副歌]

Golden hours, they don't last long
But this moment feels so strong
Every breath, a brand new start
Morning's 低语 at my heart

name: 低保真Jazz清晨回响
lyrics:
[纯音乐]


(Verse 1 - Piano)
轻柔 keys in the morning 光芒
Coffee steam and quiet 时间
Pages turning, sunbeam glow
Slow and steady, let it flow

(Chorus - Full)
Minutes 漂泊 like autumn leaves
Every moment, softly breathing
梦境 unwritten on the page
Serenade of quiet age

(Verse 2 - Muted Trumpet)
City sounds fade far away
Another 轻柔 and golden day
Melody in minor key
Whispered secrets, wild and free

(Bridge - Saxophone)
Solo saxophone sighs
湛蓝 notes painting morning skies
Every phrase a gentle kiss
Moments formed in morning mist

(Outro - Piano fade)
Keys still ringing, 消逝 slow
Let the peaceful feeling flow
Another melody complete
Dancing softly to the heat

name: 慢节奏午夜之间
lyrics:

The city sleeps but I am wide awake

Chorus:
之间 two midnights I found my way

In this space 之间 my heart and 寒冷

之间 two midnights I found my way
